title: Living High is Not a Crime

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Living High is Not a Crime is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Salam, there's a new sweet deal for you. Recently, I was approached by the guy who’s some sort of Reshala’s acquaintance. Posh as fuck, in a suit, and with a signet on his finger the size of a bottle cap. I’ve seen him at some gathering once, he used to drive a black BMW. He says that war or no war, his crib's gotta be all ornamented. Well, not exactly a crib, more like a hideout. Fetch me a bunch of jewelry, and I’ll hand it over to him. Look for horse statues, cats, lions, all that stuff. And look for Roler watches, the golden ones, it will be a complimentary gift: It’s best to be on good terms with such people, believe me, brother. Don't let me down, brother, or we're both in trouble."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 27 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Find 2 Bronze lion figurines in raid
- Find 2 Horse figurines in raid
- Find 2 Golden rooster figurines in raid
- Find 2 Cat figurine in raid
- Find 2 Roler Submariner gold wrist watch in raid
- Find 2 Golden egg in raid
- Hand over 2 Bronze lion figurines to Ragman
- Hand over 2 Horse figurines to Ragman
- Hand over 2 Golden rooster figurines to Ragman
- Hand over 2 Cat figurine to Ragman
- Hand over 2 Roler Submariner gold wrist watch to Ragman
- Hand over 2 Golden egg to Ragman

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +19,900 EXP
- Ragman Rep +0.75
"From the bottom of my heart. I’ll make the delivery. Such jewelry is always a pleasure to have, I think the guy will like it."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:

| Bronze lion figurine | 2 | Handover item | Yes |
| Horse figurine | 2 | Handover item | Yes |
| Golden rooster figurine | 2 | Handover item | Yes |
| Cat figurine | 2 | Handover item | Yes |
| Roler Submariner gold wrist watch | 2 | Handover item | Yes |
| Golden egg | 2 | Handover item | Yes |
The statues/figurines can commonly be found in the furniture displays throughout the store IDEA on Interchange. Alternatively, they, along with the Roler Submariner gold wrist watch and Golden egg can be found in Safes. They can also be very rarely be found in other containers such as Drawers, Sport bags, Dead Scavs, and more.
